en.headline: Car overturns on Lung Cheung Road flyover near Choi Hung
en.dek: A driver was briefly trapped after the car flipped near Choi Hung Estate; the Tsuen Wan-bound flyover was closed.
body: A private car overturned on the Lung Cheung Road flyover near Choi Hung Estate on Saturday morning, closing the Tsuen Wan-bound carriageway and slowing traffic in both directions.

HK01 reported that the car came off the westbound flyover at about 8:58am, struck a barrier and flipped onto its roof. The driver, a woman, was briefly trapped. Rescue workers freed her and she was treated at the scene. Sing Tao reported that she remained conscious. Police have not announced the cause.

The Transport Department said the entire Tsuen Wan-bound section of the flyover near Choi Hung Estate was closed because of the crash, and that some lanes toward Kwun Tong were also shut. It asked drivers to use other roads. RTHK reported congestion at the scene shortly after 10am.
No official injury count had been released by late morning. The driver has not been named.

zh.headline: 龍翔道近彩虹邨私家車撞壆翻側 往荃灣全線封閉
zh.dek: 女司機一度被困，在場接受治理；運輸署指往荃灣方向天橋全線封閉，現場擠塞。
body: 周六早上，一輛私家車在龍翔道天橋近彩虹邨對開翻側，往荃灣方向全線封閉，附近交通擠塞。
《香港01》報道，事發約在上午8時58分，私家車在西行天橋疑撞壆後四輪朝天。女司機一度被困，救援人員到場將她救出，並在場治理。《星島日報》稱她當時仍然清醒。警方暫未公布意外原因。
運輸署表示，因交通意外，龍翔道天橋往荃灣方向近彩虹邨的全線已封閉，往觀塘方向近彩虹邨的部分行車線亦已封閉，呼籲駕駛人士改用其他道路。香港電台上午10時後報道現場交通擠塞。
截至上午稍後，當局未有公布官方傷者數字。涉事司機未被點名。
